title: The Hungry Well
author: Jude Crane
blurb: Sebastian Iversen, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
